facts.fact: The Ministry of Health published the Annual Health Statistical Booklet for FY 2023-2024 on 10 October 2025 (figures cover FY 2023/24), derived from the Rwanda Health Management Information System (facility registers, EMRs, community health worker data) and the CRVS system including verbal autopsies.
